categories.evidence: Has the Validation label and modifies CVerifyDB::VerifyDB in src/validation.cpp to adjust chainstate verification invariants.
categories.rationale: Prevents nodes from falsely declaring database corruption and aborting startup when verifying blocks missing undo data. The PR description notes that 'getblockfrompeer restores a pruned block's body without recreating its undo record' and that at check level >2 the node 'reports database corruption, preventing the node from restarting.'
